integrity: The affine Lie-derivative identity follows exactly from the printed autonomous vector field; its compactness consequences are mathematical deductions, not numerical phase-portrait evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the 2021 autonomous equations when \(b\ne0\). It does not address \(b=0\), existence of forward-complete solutions from all initial data, finite-time discretizations, a modified 2022 model, or network control.
title: An affine drift rules out bounded dynamics in a reported four-dimensional Sprott-S extension
